form.title: Card payment
form.instruction: Please enter the amount stated on the second page of your contract (Credit card section) and your booking confirmation number
form.about: This is the secure payment page of Boat4You, part of the Europe Yachts Charter group. Boat4You processes the card payment for your charter contract, and your card statement will show Boat4You.

hints.email: We will send the payment confirmation to this address.
hints.reference: As stated in your contract, for example 100116/2027.
hints.amount: In euros, as stated in your contract, for example 1109.00.

form.securedBy: Cards · Apple Pay · Google Pay · Pay by Bank · secure payment by Mollie

errors.validation: Please check the details you entered and try again.
errors.notFound: This payment link is not valid. Please use the link in your contract.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.unavailable: Card payment is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.provider: The secure payment page could not be opened. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.reference: Please enter the booking confirmation number from your contract (3 to 64 characters: letters, digits, spaces and / - _ .).
errors.amountInvalid: Please enter a valid amount with no more than two decimals, for example 1109.00.
errors.amountAmbiguous: Please enter the amount without a thousands separator, for example 50000 or 50.00.
errors.amountTooHigh: Card payments are possible up to {max} per payment. Pay a larger amount in several payments, or by bank transfer.

confirming.title: We are confirming your payment
confirming.text: This usually takes a few seconds. Please keep this page open.

confirmed.title: Thank you, your payment has been received
confirmed.text: We have sent a payment confirmation to your e-mail address.

review.title: Your payment is being checked
review.text: Our team needs to check your payment briefly. We will confirm it by e-mail.

weWillEmail.title: Your payment is being processed
weWillEmail.text: The confirmation is taking a little longer than usual. We will e-mail you as soon as your payment is confirmed, so you can close this page.

failed.title: The payment was not completed
failed.text: Please try again, or use a different card. If you need help, write to us at info@boat4you.com.

unavailable.title: Card payment is not available right now
unavailable.text: Please try again later. If you have already paid, you will receive a confirmation by e-mail. If you need help, write to us at info@boat4you.com.

legal.received: Payments are received by Cusmanich d.o.o. in the name and for the account of the Operator.
